preferred_house_rationale: House 5 is in the published three-device intersection, is not among the three households whose aggregate readings were reported to have solar interference, and its cleaned CSV is listed in the Zenodo record.
license: CC BY 4.0 as shown on official Strathclyde data page and Zenodo record

measurement_contract.publisher_page_description: 20 households, aggregate and appliance active power in Watts, nominal 8-second sampling, October 2013 to June 2015.
measurement_contract.cleaned_readme_description: CSV fields include DateTime, Unix timestamp, Aggregate, and Appliance1 through Appliance9; logger polled approximately every 6-8 seconds and sensors were not synchronized.
measurement_contract.sensor_alignment_note: The cleaned ReadMe says readings were change-triggered and forward-filled; a sensor could have updated anywhere in the preceding 6-8 seconds. Do not treat nominal sample timestamps as synchronized action boundaries.
measurement_contract.cleaning_note: The cleaned publisher page says duplicate timestamps were merged, IAM values above 4000 W zeroed, and NaNs forward-filled for gaps under 2 minutes or zeroed for longer gaps. A zero can be imputed rather than an observed off-state.
measurement_contract.official_issues_definition: CLEAN_READ_ME_081116.txt defines Issues=1 as the sum of nine appliance readings exceeding the aggregate reading; discard the row or explicitly note the inconsistency. Monitor-move sections were remapped during cleaning.

trace_listing.note: The complete Zenodo House 5 CSV was downloaded. Its byte size is 435,272,416 and MD5 matches the record. The Zenodo record lists six household CSVs despite describing a 20-household dataset, so it remains a partial file listing of REFIT as a whole.

partial_trace_probe.sampling_method: Fixed-position convenience probes, not a random sample; partial first and last CSV rows excluded.
partial_trace_probe.permitted_use: Format, channel activity, and quality-flag sanity check only.
partial_trace_probe.prohibited_inference: Do not estimate full-file quality rates, device-cycle counts, conflict prevalence, or coordination effects from these ranges.

full_trace_audit.method_note: Initial observational summary only. REFIT cleaning can forward-fill or zero-fill; numeric completeness does not imply raw observation or an observed off-state.

pre_dehumidifier_overlap_probe.interpretation: Counts are 8-second sample rows under an exploratory threshold, not independent events or task conflicts; do not use as event prevalence.

pre_dehumidifier_activity_bout_probe.interpretation: Naive contiguous threshold runs are short, fragmented power phases; do not treat them as service cycles or use their durations as task service times.

pre_dehumidifier_coactivity_window_probe.interpretation: Observed same-row power co-activity only. These are correlated sample windows, not independent task conflicts, user requests, or appliance cycles.

pre_dehumidifier_coactivity_context_audi.interpretation: Strict boundary means only that immediately adjacent records on both ends have Issues=0 and, within 16 seconds, at least one channel in the device pair is below 100 W so the pair no longer jointly meets the activity threshold. It does not establish a full appliance cycle, task, or conflict; the 20 windows remain a priority review subset.

triple_coactivity_within_long_pair_revie.scope: Only source rows inside the 108 selected >=5-minute pair windows at 100 W; not a full-trace census.
triple_coactivity_within_long_pair_revie.interpretation: This is evidence of one observed three-channel high-load interval in cleaned household data, not evidence of three user tasks, a circuit-limit violation, or Agent conflict. Its exact endpoints are uncertain because the adjacent rows are quality-flagged; the same source interval appears in three pair windows and has been deduplicated.

official_channel_mapping.mapping_scope: appliances known to be monitored at the beginning of the study period; publisher cannot guarantee that occupants did not later remove or switch monitored devices

house5_changes.note: A dehumidifier was added. Treat this channel as potentially mixed from this date onward; exclude post-date readings from dryer-only analysis unless separability is established.
Signature change in Computer Site; not one of the target three channels but retained as a documented household change.

secondary_house_recheck.cross_house_observation: At least one washer-dishwasher co-activity interval lasts 443 seconds at 100 W and 323 seconds at 300 W; both candidate boundaries are quality-clear and below threshold. This is measured power co-activity only, not a task or conflict label.
secondary_house_recheck.reviewer_status: machine checks passed; independent human review pending

three_channel_scan.scope: All 100 W pair windows across the audited date range; Issues=1 excluded and gaps over 16 seconds break runs
three_channel_scan.result: No clear same-row triple activity at >=100 W. This excludes only this operational threshold on the publisher-cleaned trace.

house3_triple_coactivity_screen.scope: All 84 combinations of Appliance1..Appliance9; full trace; same-row measured power; Issues=1 excluded and breaks bouts; timestamp gaps >16 seconds break bouts.
house3_triple_coactivity_screen.interpretation: Observed thresholded channel co-activity only; not appliance-cycle, task, deadline, circuit-capacity, or Agent-conflict evidence.
